rows.name: Kit_DoorFrame_Wood_DA
rows.differs: Lobby FREE (L0-F) frame, double-acting: walnut sleeve casing on both faces over the map trims, oak 12 mm saddle, black brush seals and fins on the wall centre plane, brass pivot caps; no stop, no butts, no closer shoe.
rows.era_note: 1990 back-of-house / corridor double-acting doors on centre-hung pivots (A12/A19, Red 2026-10-22); no brands.

rows.name: Kit_DoorFrame_Steel_DA
rows.differs: Pressed-steel double-acting frame (L0-K, OF-F, OF-K, RN): dark-bronze sleeve casing both faces, bronze saddle, brush seals and fins, chrome pivot caps.
rows.era_note: 1990 back-of-house / corridor double-acting doors on centre-hung pivots (A12/A19, Red 2026-10-22); no brands.

rows.name: Kit_DoorLeaf_Veneer_DA
